name: Screen and validate a new product candidate
human_role: Product researcher doing first-pass triage before any real research time is spent
inputs_required: brand brain: store type and category tags

steps.name: Log the candidate and start the clock
steps.does: Open a research-log entry for the candidate with a hard time-box (default 2 hours).
steps.output: research log entry with a deadline
steps.check: the entry has a stop time before any research starts

steps.name: Run the fast screen and read trend against saturation
steps.does: Check category size, pain evidence, scarcity and store-model fit against the fixed checklist; pull the multi-year trend line and count existing sellers in the same pass.
steps.output: pass/caution/reject with reasons, plus a trend-and-saturation read
steps.check: every check has a stated reason and the trend line covers at least 2 years

steps.name: Validate demand on video-commerce and social-native platforms
steps.does: If the candidate is trend-flagged, check its demand signal on TikTok-style shop data and native ad feeds so one viral clip is not mistaken for proof.
steps.check: the signal is seen on 2 or more independent sources, not one clip

steps.name: Scout ad libraries for sustained competitor spend
steps.does: Search public ad libraries and spy tools for products with real, sustained spend in the category, and read what gap the incumbents leave.
steps.output: competitor scouting sheet (words and numbers only)
steps.check: no competitor asset, text, logo or product image is copied, only signal notes

steps.name: Mine reviews on the closest listings for the price buyers actually pay
steps.does: Read reviews on the nearest DTC and Amazon listings for price complaints and willingness-to-pay signals.
steps.check: every price signal quotes its source review

steps.name: Delegate repetitive search steps and close the time box
steps.does: Hand repeatable search legwork to a sub-agent pass so the time box is not spent typing searches by hand; stop at the deadline regardless of state.
steps.check: the stop time from step 1 was respected

steps.name: Score the candidate and log the verdict
steps.does: Combine the screen, demand validation, scouting sheet and price signal into one verdict: pass, caution or reject, with the reason for each part.
steps.check: the verdict traces to at least one concrete piece of evidence per part

steps.name: Hand off pass and caution candidates
steps.does: Send a pass or caution candidate to the differentiation workflow (PROD-W02) and the economics gate (PROD-W03); log a one-line reason for any reject.
steps.output: handoff note to PROD-W02 and PROD-W03
steps.check: every candidate has exactly one next step named

qa: every check has a stated reason
no competitor asset copied, signal only
the time box was respected and logged
no candidate reaches sourcing spend without this screen
read_point: at hand-off: whether the candidate proceeds to differentiation and economics within the time-box window
typical_duration: agent time under 2 hours per candidate; no external wait
subagents: PROD-Research sub-agent runs the whole screen so several candidates can be screened in parallel

name: Extend the line and sharpen the differentiation angle
human_role: Product manager planning the next SKUs and the cash plan behind them
inputs_required: brand brain: hero product performance and SKU list

steps.name: Pull the hero product's performance and the category default
steps.does: Read the hero SKU's sales, margin and reviews, and note what the category's default product looks like.
steps.check: numbers come from the metric contract, not memory

steps.name: Name the one differentiating thing
steps.does: State the single feature or angle that differs from the category default, backed by the gap already scouted in PROD-W01.
steps.check: the angle traces to a real, cited competitor gap, not an assumption

steps.name: Draft 2 to 3 line-extension options
steps.does: Propose SKU options that build on the differentiation angle rather than copying the hero product.
steps.check: each option states what it adds over the hero SKU

steps.name: Tag the demand pattern for each option
steps.does: Classify each option evergreen, trending or seasonal using sales history and category norms.
steps.check: the tag has a stated evidence source

steps.name: Map seasonal and gifting spikes
steps.does: Plot any seasonal or gifting spike against the calendar for options tagged seasonal.
steps.check: spikes are read from at least one full prior cycle where data exists

steps.name: Check whether a subscription is earned
steps.does: Look for real repeat-purchase evidence before proposing a subscription model; otherwise flag the SKU a one-time novelty.
steps.check: the verdict is based on repeat_rate_90d/365d, not founder preference

steps.name: Size the cash and stock plan the pattern implies
steps.does: Compute, in code, the cash and stock commitment implied by the demand pattern (e.g., pre-buy for a seasonal spike).
steps.check: every number is computed, not estimated

steps.name: Log and hand off
steps.does: Log the differentiation brief and demand-pattern tags to the registry and hand the SKU options to the economics gate.
steps.check: the brief is complete enough for PROD-W03 to run without asking a question

qa: angle traces to a cited gap, not an invented claim
demand tag has evidence
cash numbers computed in code
read_point: when the SKU reaches the economics gate: whether the angle holds at the compliance and margin check
typical_duration: agent time under 1 hour; no external wait

name: Model economics, run the compliance gate and decide go/no-go
human_role: Product manager running the funding decision with the founder
inputs_required: cost basis (unit cost, freight, duty estimate)

steps.name: Pull cost basis, target price and the brand's margin floor
steps.does: Read the real cost inputs and the brand's own floor, never a course number or industry rule of thumb.
steps.check: the floor is the brand's own, cited to where it was set

steps.name: Run the margin and compliance gate in code
steps.does: Compute price, shipping, shelf-life and regulatory checks together as one pass/fail gate.
steps.output: gate result with the full number breakdown
steps.check: a missing input blocks the gate rather than defaulting to an assumption

steps.name: Score expansion markets if relevant
steps.does: If the candidate targets more than the home market, score each market's gate result separately.
steps.check: each market is gated on its own numbers, not the home market's

steps.name: Apply the remaining go-live gates
steps.does: Check provable claims, an owned point of difference, the brand's own thresholds, contribution margin and ad-cost headroom together.
steps.check: every claim used in the gate is in the approved or site-backed tier

steps.name: Rank surviving candidates
steps.does: If more than one candidate cleared the gates, rank them on the fixed scorecard.
steps.output: ranked shortlist with score parts visible
steps.check: no arithmetic done in the model; source carries no extra weight

steps.name: Write the one-page go/no-go memo
steps.does: State the candidate, the evidence, the cost, what it could move on the metric contract, and the gate results.
steps.check: reading level under grade 10; every number in the memo is in the record

steps.name: Set the pre-set review date
steps.does: For anything recommended for approval, set the date the result gets checked.
steps.output: review date on the registry entry
steps.check: the review date is a real calendar date or a count, not "soon"

steps.name: Send to the founder gate and log the decision
steps.does: Send the card with the 3 buttons; log whatever the founder decides, with their reason verbatim.
steps.check: the founder's reason is stored verbatim, not paraphrased

qa: every input has a source
missing inputs blocked the gate
claims traced to tiers
a review date is set for anything approved
read_point: the pre-set review date logged on approval
typical_duration: agent time 1 to 2 hours; founder decision adds 1 to 3 days wait

name: Run field research and hand the validated angle to creative
human_role: Product researcher grounding the angle in real shopper behaviour before Creative builds on it

steps.name: Define the field-research question
steps.does: State exactly what shopper behaviour would confirm or kill the current angle.
steps.check: the question is answerable within the time budget

steps.name: Run the field pass within its time limit
steps.does: Read interviews, forums, reviews and in-market signals for the question, stopping at the time limit.
steps.check: the time limit was not exceeded

steps.name: Extract the validated detail
steps.does: Pull out the avatar detail, hook language and any onboarding idea that actually surfaced in real shopper words.
steps.check: every note quotes or closely paraphrases a real source

steps.name: Check against the differentiation brief
steps.does: Flag any contradiction between the field finding and the differentiation brief from PROD-W02.
steps.check: a contradiction is never silently dropped

steps.name: Package the handoff note
steps.does: Write the validated angle, hook and onboarding idea as a short handoff, with the source evidence attached.
steps.check: reading level under grade 10; every claim in the note has a source

steps.name: Send the handoff and log it
steps.does: Send the note to Paid creative and copy, and to Site for any onboarding idea; log the handoff.
steps.check: the receiving agent and date are both recorded

qa: every finding traces to a real shopper source
the time limit was respected
read_point: when Creative reports whether the angle tested; the read is logged by CREA and referenced here
typical_duration: agent time 1 to 3 hours depending on field access

name: Build the tech pack, BOM, packaging spec and durability test
trigger: event: new SKU or spec change | event: new packaging design
human_role: Product/QA manager writing the exact spec a factory builds to

steps.name: Write measurements with tolerance bands
steps.does: Specify every physical dimension with a tolerance, never a bare number.
steps.check: every measurement has a tolerance band

steps.name: Build the component-level BOM
steps.does: List every component with its own spec and target cost.
steps.check: every component has a spec and a target cost

steps.name: Price packaging as its own cost line
steps.does: Cost packaging separately from the product, never folded into a single unit cost.
steps.check: packaging appears as its own line, not blended into unit cost

steps.name: Version the tech pack
steps.does: Assign a version number and log it against the SKU record.
steps.check: the version number is unique and traceable to the SKU

steps.name: Book the packaging durability test
steps.does: Book the drop-test, tamper-evidence and transit-durability test the design needs before production.
steps.check: the test is booked before any production run, not after

steps.name: Track the test result
steps.does: Record pass, fail or marginal against the stated pass criteria.
steps.check: the result states which specific criterion failed, if any

steps.name: Update and re-book on failure
steps.does: If the packaging fails, revise the spec, bump the version, and re-book the test.
steps.check: no unversioned change is made to a failed spec

steps.name: Hand off to sourcing
steps.does: Send the versioned, tested tech pack to sourcing for RFQ.
steps.check: the tech pack handed off has a passed durability result or an explicit waiver reason

qa: every measurement has a tolerance
packaging is its own cost line
the durability test is booked before production, not after
read_point: when the packaging test result returns: pass, hold or redesign
typical_duration: agent time 2 to 4 hours; packaging lab turnaround 3 to 10 days

name: Discover, vet, watch and score suppliers, and monitor commodity costs
trigger: on demand (new supplier) | weekly background scan | monthly (scorecard, commodity watch)
human_role: Sourcing manager running the full supplier relationship from first search to the ongoing scorecard

steps.name: Pick the region and run the discovery funnel
steps.does: Run the region-specific discovery procedure: broad platform search against the open spec.
steps.check: the funnel used the region's own primary platform, not a generic search

steps.name: Message a wide shortlist on the same spec
steps.does: Contact the shortlist with identical spec and terms so responses are comparable.
steps.check: every message sent used the same spec text

steps.name: Verify with a video call and certification check
steps.does: Verify the top responders with a live video call and a certification document check.
steps.check: no supplier is added to the verified list on claims alone

steps.name: Vet any sourcing agent the same way
steps.does: Apply the same verification standard to a sourcing agent as to a factory.
steps.check: an agent is vetted, never assumed reliable because a factory recommended them

steps.name: Keep the spec running in the background
steps.does: Leave the open spec live against IndiaMART, Alibaba and Global Sources for a better or new supplier.
steps.check: the watch only alerts; it never contacts a supplier on its own

steps.name: Score active suppliers monthly
steps.does: Score every active supplier on on-time delivery, defect rate, responsiveness and price stability.
steps.check: the scorecard uses real delivery and defect data, not opinion

steps.name: Track commodity input costs
steps.does: Track the priced-in raw materials behind each SKU on a set cadence.
steps.check: the flag names the exact input and the price move

steps.name: Flag when a cost-down is not worth the risk
steps.does: Compare a possible cost-down against the relationship-risk cost of pushing too hard.
steps.check: the recommendation states the risk it is weighing, not just the saving

steps.name: Log everything
steps.does: Log the shortlist, scorecard, commodity flag and any risk recommendation to the registry.
steps.check: every entry links to the prior entry for the same supplier

qa: every supplier verified by video call and certification, not claims alone
scorecard uses real data
the background watch never contacts a supplier automatically
read_point: monthly scorecard review; the alert's read point is when the founder decides to open a conversation
typical_duration: agent time 2 to 6 hours for a discovery pass; the weekly scan runs unattended; human calls add days

name: Draft the RFQ, compare quotes and confirm landed cost
human_role: Sourcing manager turning a spec into a purchasing decision

steps.name: Translate the spec into a structured RFQ
steps.does: Turn the tech pack into an RFQ with tolerance bands stated plainly.
steps.check: every measurement in the RFQ matches the tech pack's tolerance

steps.name: Send the RFQ on identical terms
steps.does: Send to the shortlist with the same terms and the same deadline.
steps.check: every supplier received the same terms and deadline

steps.name: Collect quotes across volume tiers
steps.does: Gather quotes for each stated volume tier from every responding supplier.
steps.check: every quote covers every requested volume tier or states why not

steps.name: Build landed cost per SKU in code
steps.does: Compute product, freight, duty and packaging cost with a backup test for every cost line.
steps.output: landed cost model per volume tier
steps.check: every cost line has a source and a backup-tested check

steps.name: Compare cost and cash impact across tiers
steps.does: Compare landed cost per unit and the cash impact of each volume tier.
steps.check: the comparison shows cash impact, not just unit cost

steps.name: Flag incomplete quotes
steps.does: Flag any quote missing a required certification or term.
steps.check: a flagged quote is excluded from the recommendation until resolved

steps.name: Recommend a supplier and tier
steps.does: Recommend a supplier and volume tier with the full numbers shown.
steps.check: the recommendation names the numbers it is based on

steps.name: Hand landed cost to Money and Ops
steps.does: Hand the landed cost model to Money and Ops to confirm and own for the brand's P&L.
steps.check: Money confirms receipt before the model is treated as final

outputs: landed cost model per volume tier
qa: every cost line has a backup-tested source
quotes compared on identical terms
landed cost computed in code, never estimated
read_point: when Money confirms the landed cost model for the P&L
typical_duration: agent time 2 to 3 hours; supplier quote turnaround 3 to 10 days

name: Run the sample gate, negotiate the price and book the production slot
human_role: Sourcing/QA manager gating the sample and locking the deal
inputs_required: approved reference sample (in-house and at factory)

steps.name: Confirm the reference sample exists
steps.does: Check the approved reference sample is in-house before any comparison starts.
steps.check: no comparison starts without a confirmed in-house reference

steps.name: Run the 3-stage gate
steps.does: Compare the new sample against the reference side by side across the 3 stages.
steps.check: every stage records a pass, hold or reject

steps.name: Score communication and reliability
steps.does: Score the factory's communication and reliability shown during the sample round.
steps.check: the score is based on response time and accuracy, not tone

steps.name: Record the deviation
steps.does: Record the exact deviation for any hold or reject, in measurable terms.
steps.check: the deviation is stated as a measurement, not a feeling

steps.name: Build negotiating leverage
steps.does: If the sample passed, build real leverage: a vetted alternate factory, a competitor teardown, the category's normal factory margin.
steps.check: the leverage is real (a vetted alternate exists), not a bluff

steps.name: Ask for the cost-down
steps.does: Present the ask with the leverage stated plainly, not as a bare request.
steps.check: the ask names the specific leverage used

steps.name: Confirm price and book the slot
steps.does: Confirm the final price and terms, then book the production slot at the exact factory.
steps.check: the slot is booked at the exact factory that passed the sample, not a sister factory

steps.name: Track the slot weekly
steps.does: Check the booked slot is still on schedule until production starts.
steps.check: a slip is flagged the week it becomes known, not after

steps.name: Log the decision
steps.does: Log the sample decision, negotiated price and slot booking to the registry.
steps.check: no creative shoot, price commitment or launch date is set before this log exists

qa: reference sample existed before comparison
no downstream commitment before the sample clears
leverage is real, not a bluff
read_point: when the booked slot's production start date arrives; a slip is flagged the day it is known
typical_duration: agent time 1 to 2 hours per stage; sample shipping and factory response add 1 to 3 weeks

name: Structure payment terms and hand PO governance to Finance
human_role: Sourcing manager setting the deal's cash terms and governance

steps.name: Choose the payment route
steps.does: Pick wire, LC, trade assurance or escrow based on the supplier relationship's history and risk.
steps.check: the route matches the relationship's actual risk level, not a default

steps.name: Structure the split and MOQ
steps.does: Set the advance, balance and retention split, and confirm the MOQ.
steps.check: the split is stated as percentages tied to milestones

steps.name: Compute float, cash-locked figure and financing cost
steps.does: Compute, in code, the float days, the cash locked up, and any financing cost.
steps.check: every figure is computed, not estimated

steps.name: Hand the numbers to Finance
steps.does: Send the full cash/MOQ packet to Finance at deal close.
steps.check: Finance confirms receipt before the deal proceeds

steps.name: Gate the PO on the tech pack version
steps.does: Confirm the PO cites the exact, current tech pack version, never a verbal spec.
steps.check: the PO references a specific tech pack version number

steps.name: Assign one owner and one date per step
steps.does: Confirm one named owner and one date for every step on the production critical path.
steps.check: every step has exactly one owner and one date

steps.name: Route communication through one channel
steps.does: Route all supplier communication for this PO through one logged channel.
steps.check: no side-channel communication about this PO exists unlogged

steps.name: Log the governed PO
steps.does: Log the PO and its governance record to the registry.
steps.check: the record links the PO, the tech pack version and the owner list

qa: every float day and financing cost computed, not estimated
the PO cites the exact tech pack version
one owner and one date per production step
read_point: at Finance's cash review, and at each production-step date
typical_duration: agent time under 1 hour; Finance review adds 1 to 2 days

name: Run pre-shipment inspection and choose freight and 3PL
human_role: Sourcing/logistics manager clearing a shipment for departure

steps.name: Book third-party inspection
steps.does: Book third-party inspection before the container leaves the factory.
steps.check: inspection is booked before the shipment date, not after

steps.name: Size the defect buffer from real history
steps.does: Size the acceptable defect buffer from this SKU's own defect history, not a flat industry percentage.
steps.check: the buffer cites the SKU's own historical defect rate

steps.name: Record disposition decisions
steps.does: Record what happens to every defective unit found: rework, discount, discard.
steps.check: every defective unit has a recorded decision

steps.name: Pick the freight mode
steps.does: Choose air, sea or a hybrid by weight, launch date and cash cover.
steps.check: the decision states the weight/date/cash trade-off it made

steps.name: Select the 3PL on service history
steps.does: Choose the 3PL on service history, not the lowest quote.
steps.check: the selection cites the 3PL's on-time and damage-rate history

steps.name: Check cross-border thresholds
steps.does: Check duty thresholds and paperwork requirements before committing.
steps.check: the check is done before the shipment is booked, not after

steps.name: Clear the shipment to leave
steps.does: Confirm the shipment is cleared, with the inspection result attached.
steps.check: clearance is recorded with the inspection result attached, not separately

steps.name: Log the choices
steps.does: Log the freight/3PL choice and inspection result to the registry.
steps.check: the record links to the PO it ships against

qa: defect buffer sized from real history
3PL chosen on service history, not price alone
cross-border threshold checked before commit
read_point: on arrival: whether the defect rate matched the inspection's estimate
typical_duration: agent time 1 to 2 hours; inspection turnaround 1 to 3 days

name: Audit the sourcing base: onboarding, billing anomalies and defect CAPA
trigger: event: onboarding or new client | per billing cycle | on defect complaint above a threshold
human_role: Sourcing/ops manager running standing governance over the whole supplier and courier base
inputs_required: contracted rates for suppliers, couriers and 3PLs

steps.name: Audit the whole sourcing base once
steps.does: On onboarding, audit every active supplier, term and price in one pass.
steps.check: every active supplier appears in the audit, none skipped

steps.name: Set the PO cadence to the SKU count
steps.does: At high SKU count, move purchase orders from a weekly to a daily cadence.
steps.check: the cadence change is logged with the SKU-count threshold that triggered it

steps.name: Watch bills against contracted rates
steps.does: Watch every recurring supplier and courier bill against its contracted rate, in code.
steps.check: the check compares against the contracted rate, not last month's bill

steps.name: Flag anomalies the month they appear
steps.does: Flag a quiet rate increase, a duplicate charge or a new surcharge the same billing cycle it appears.
steps.check: the flag is raised within the same billing cycle

steps.name: Track 3PL and warehouse SLA daily
steps.does: Track 3PL and warehouse SLA performance daily against the written SLA.
steps.check: a breach is flagged the day it happens, not at month end

steps.name: Trace a defect to its batch
steps.does: When a defect complaint crosses the threshold, trace it to the exact production batch or lot using the tech pack's versioning.
steps.check: the trace names the exact batch or lot, not just the SKU

steps.name: Run the CAPA loop
steps.does: Run the corrective-action loop with the supplier: root cause, fix, verification.
steps.check: the CAPA has a verified fix, not just a supplier promise

steps.name: Log everything
steps.does: Log every anomaly, SLA breach and CAPA outcome to the registry.
steps.check: every entry links back to the specific supplier, courier or 3PL

qa: every anomaly computed against the contracted rate, not a feeling
batch trace uses the tech pack's own versioning
CAPA has a verified fix
read_point: the CAPA's verification date; the next billing cycle for anomaly recurrence
typical_duration: agent time 2 to 4 hours for onboarding audit; billing/SLA checks run unattended weekly

name: Compute reorder points and manage DTC and Amazon FBA replenishment
human_role: Inventory planner sizing every SKU's reorder point and channel-specific replenishment
inputs_required: Amazon IPI and storage limits if applicable

steps.name: Pull real velocity and lead time
steps.does: Pull real velocity and lead time per SKU per channel; a subscription or bundle SKU uses committed cadence, not trailing sales.
steps.check: velocity and lead time are real numbers, not defaults

steps.name: Compute reorder point and safety stock
steps.does: Compute reorder point and safety stock in code, sized against India-specific spike risk (festive demand, COD RTO).
steps.output: reorder point and safety stock per SKU
steps.check: the spike-risk adjustment is stated, not silently folded in

steps.name: Compare current stock to the reorder point
steps.does: Compare current stock against the computed point and flag stockout risk.
steps.check: every SKU below its reorder point is flagged

steps.name: Size non-routine orders
steps.does: Size any non-routine order from the committed channel push plan (a promotion or launch).
steps.check: the size traces to a committed plan, not a guess

steps.name: Size Amazon FBA replenishment
steps.does: Size FBA replenishment shipments from a real cover target, treating a stockout as the failure mode to avoid.
steps.check: the cover target is the brand's own, not a platform default

steps.name: Watch IPI and storage limits
steps.does: Watch Amazon IPI score and storage limits live so a restock is never blocked.
steps.check: the flag is raised before the limit blocks a restock, not after

steps.name: Draft the PO
steps.does: Draft a PO for every SKU below its reorder point.
steps.check: the draft covers every flagged SKU

steps.name: Log the plan
steps.does: Log the reorder plan and any PO draft to the registry.
steps.check: the plan is dated and links to the SKU record

outputs: reorder point and safety stock per SKU
qa: velocity and lead time are real numbers, not defaults
IPI limit checked before a restock is planned
arithmetic computed in code
read_point: weekly, against actual stockouts and IPI score
typical_duration: agent time under 1 hour, runs unattended weekly

name: Flag concentration risk, refresh landed cost and flag dead stock
human_role: Sourcing/inventory manager watching structural risk and ageing stock together
inputs_required: current FX, freight and duty rates
stock age and velocity by channel

steps.name: Compute concentration shares
steps.does: Compute supplier and country concentration shares across the sourcing base.
steps.output: concentration share by supplier and country
steps.check: shares are computed in code from the ledger, not estimated

steps.name: Confirm a mapped backup
steps.does: Confirm a mapped backup supplier exists in a second country for any concentrated share.
steps.check: the backup is a real, vetted supplier, not assumed

steps.name: Recompute landed cost on any change
steps.does: Recompute landed cost the moment price, freight, FX or duty changes.
steps.check: the recompute is triggered by an actual rate change, not on a fixed calendar only

steps.name: Watch inventory age against velocity
steps.does: Watch stock age against velocity across DTC and marketplace stock.
steps.check: the table covers every channel the SKU sells on

steps.name: Flag before it becomes dead weight
steps.does: Flag a SKU against the long-term storage or dead-stock threshold before it becomes dead weight.
steps.check: the alert fires before the threshold is crossed, not after

steps.name: Draft the clearance options
steps.does: Draft a markdown, bundle or discontinue plan with the cash impact of each option.
steps.output: clearance plan with cash impact per option
steps.check: every option's cash impact is computed, not estimated

steps.name: Send to the founder gate
steps.does: Send the concentration-risk and dead-stock flags to the founder gate.
steps.check: the card names what it costs to act and what it costs to wait

steps.name: Log the refresh
steps.does: Log the refreshed landed cost and clearance decision to the registry.
steps.check: the log links to the prior month's entry for trend

qa: backup supplier is mapped, not assumed
landed cost recomputed on every relevant price move
clearance cash numbers computed, not estimated
read_point: founder decision on the clearance plan; next month's concentration recompute
typical_duration: agent time 1 to 2 hours monthly; dead-stock sweep runs unattended weekly

name: Sync multi-channel inventory, route orders and plan peak-season capacity
trigger: continuous; event: new channel added | annual, ahead of festive season
human_role: Inventory/ops planner keeping one stock pool safe across channels and ready for peak season
inputs_required: stock pool across site, marketplaces, quick commerce and stores

steps.name: Keep one synced stock pool
steps.does: Keep one stock pool synced across every channel with per-channel buffers to stop overselling.
steps.check: no channel oversells against its buffer

steps.name: Set routing and split-shipment rules
steps.does: Set order routing and split-shipment rules by channel and warehouse.
steps.check: every channel has a stated routing rule, none default by accident

steps.name: Reconcile the pool daily
steps.does: Reconcile the stock pool daily and flag any channel drifting out of sync.
steps.check: drift is flagged the day it is detected

steps.name: Project peak-season safety stock
steps.does: Ahead of the festive season, project the safety stock needed across the season.
steps.check: the projection uses at least one prior festive cycle's data where it exists

steps.name: Check staffing and system load
steps.does: Check warehouse staffing and WMS/OMS load against the projected peak volume.
steps.check: the check states a percentage of capacity used, not a yes/no

steps.name: Build the readiness plan
steps.does: Build the festive readiness plan rolling stock, staffing and system load into one plan.
steps.check: the plan covers stock, staffing and system load together, not just stock

steps.name: Send to the founder gate
steps.does: Send the readiness plan to the founder gate ahead of the season.
steps.check: the card is sent with enough lead time to act on any gap

steps.name: Log the rules and plan
steps.does: Log the sync rules and readiness plan to the registry.
steps.check: the log is dated and versioned for the season

qa: no channel oversells against the buffer policy
readiness plan covers stock, staffing and system load together
read_point: peak season's actual stockout and fulfilment-delay rate against the plan
typical_duration: agent time 2 to 3 hours annually for the readiness plan; sync runs continuously

name: Select a fulfilment 3PL/WMS and build warehouse and returns workflows
trigger: on demand (3PL/WMS selection) | weekly (warehouse ops) | ongoing, reviewed weekly (returns)
human_role: Fulfilment manager standing up or resetting domestic fulfilment operations

steps.name: Run the RFP and SLA negotiation
steps.does: Run the RFP and SLA negotiation for a domestic fulfilment 3PL, separate from import-side freight.
steps.check: the SLA states numeric targets, not general commitments

steps.name: Run the integration test
steps.does: Run the integration test for the 3PL's WMS before go-live.
steps.check: go-live does not happen before the integration test passes

steps.name: Set slotting rules
